args: ctx="${SERENA_MCP_CONTEXT:-}"; if [ -z "$ctx" ]; then ctx="agent"; pid="$PPID"; while [ "$pid" -gt 1 ]; do parent="$(ps -o args= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"; case "$parent" in *claude*) ctx="claude-code"; break ;; *codex*) ctx="codex"; break ;; esac; next="$(ps -o ppid= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"; case "$next" in ''|*[!0-9]*) break ;; esac; pid="$next"; done; fi; exec serena start-mcp-server --context "$ctx" --project-from-cwd
